device_entry.description: 用于实验自动化中的非实体软件通信组件，通过串口发送文本命令并等待返回字符串，适合与基于 SCPI 的 Zahner 电化学仪器控制流程配合使用。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software communication component used in lab automation to send text commands over a serial port and wait for returned strings, suitable for SCPI-based control workflows with Zahner electrochemical instruments.

schema.description: 等待指定命令类型的串口回复字符串。

schema.description_en: Send a string command and wait for the corresponding serial response.
